answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to post a refundable bond before it may attest transactions, with the bond slashed if its attestations are later proven false. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, while honest work earns the bond back, so an attacker must pay real capital per identity. Like a single ember giving off only a faint pulse of heat, one unfunded identity carries almost no weight, and an umber ledger of past slashes lets peers see which identities have burned their stake before trusting them again.
